summary: Ventas, Inc. filed an 8-K covering two routine items: (1) a separation agreement with departing executive Peter J. Bulgarelli providing a prorated 2026 bonus in exchange for a standard release and continued restrictive covenant compliance, a customary compensatory arrangement upon retirement; and (2) the 2026 Annual Meeting results, including election of 12 director nominees and voting on other proposals as described in the proxy statement. Neither item constitutes a special situation such as a takeover, restructuring, or activist campaign. The filing is a routine current report reflecting standard corporate housekeeping and governance events.
